model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the weekly number of newly diagnosed cases and newly reported deaths related to COVID-19 from July 15, 2022, to September 26, 2022. The horizontal axis represents time, with dates labeled at approximately seven-day intervals from July 15, 2022, to September 26, 2022, and is not sorted in any particular order. The vertical axis represents the number of cases and deaths, with two scales: a left-hand scale labeled “每周新增患者人数” (weekly new cases) ranging from 0 to 1,800,000 in increments of 200,000, and a right-hand scale labeled “每周媒体每日报道数” (weekly media daily reports) ranging from 0 to 6,000 in increments of 1,000. The chart consists of two sets of bars for each date: a teal bar representing “该工作站确诊数量” (confirmed cases at the workstation) and a light blue bar representing “有关covid-19新闻数量” (number of COVID-19 news reports). For example, on July 15, 2022, the teal bar reaches approximately 1,100,000 while the light blue bar reaches approximately 3,200; conversely, on September 26, 2022, the teal bar reaches approximately 200,000 and the light blue bar reaches approximately 1,000. The teal bars generally fluctuate between approximately 200,000 and 1,600,000 throughout the period, while the light blue bars fluctuate between approximately 1,000 and 5,000. No bars are visually emphasized.
